sections.title: Habit and range
sections.text: Combretum paniculatum is a climbing liana or scrambling shrub from tropical Africa, extending south to Limpopo. Its opposite leaves can reach about 18 × 9.5 cm. The plate shows a climbing plant; the sources do not provide a reliable height to report.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Red flowers are borne in panicles and the dry fruits have four or five wings, about 2–2.5 cm long. The plate's scarlet flowers and winged fruits fit the species. No food use is established here.
